e.summary_en: A deterministic insurance document-extraction SDK (Apache-2.0, 127 versions): parsing and structuring primitives for regulated AI agents
e.summary_hk: 確定性保險文檔抽取 SDK（Apache-2.0，127 個版本）：面向受監管 agent 的文檔解析與結構化基元
e.body:
CL-SDK（`@claritylabs/cl-sdk`，npm，Apache-2.0，最新 4.6.0 / 2026-08-11，**自 2026-03-22 起已发布 127 个版本**）自我定位为「**Deterministic insurance intelligence primitives for regulated AI agents**」（面向受监管 AI agent 的**确定性**保险智能基元），README 达 13,362 字并附独立文档站（`cl-sdk.claritylabs.inc/docs`）；首位能力是 **Document Extraction — 源树抽取（source-tree extraction）**，即把解析器产物结构化为可用的保险文档数据。

对 RIAA：这条的价值点在「**deterministic（确定性）**」与「**regulated（受监管）**」这两个限定词上——它们精准描述了保险业采用 AI 时最难的那道门槛：**监管要求结论可复现、可追溯，而生成式模型本质是概率性的**。池内此前已有一条思路相近的条目 [[quorumforge]]（对智能体审议记录做**确定性裁决**，同输入同字节同摘要），CL-SDK 补的是**文档环节**的确定性：把非结构化保单/条款转成结构化数据时，让抽取结果可复现而非「每次略有不同」。它与池内文档抽取族形成分工：[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]（中文条款数据集）、[[suture-vlm]]（核保 binder 差异检测 VLM）、[[erax-vl]]（越南语保险单据多模态抽取）、[[evidence-review-claims]]（图像证据裁决）；治理与可信度侧见 [[insurance-governance]]、[[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]；实务 agent 侧见 [[agrisky-ai]]（农险查勘定损，同样强调「模型不得改写关键数值」的确定性设计）。适合作文档自动化、受监管 AI 与 agent 工程方向。

**核实说明**：npm 官方元数据与 README 已核实；其 GitHub 仓库 `claritylabs-inc/cl-sdk` 可访问（Apache-2.0、TypeScript、2.1MB），但**仓库描述与 topics 为空、星标仅 1**，故本词条的能力描述**主要依据 npm README 与官方文档站**，未对其实现质量作评判。
e.body_en:
CL-SDK (`@claritylabs/cl-sdk`, npm, Apache-2.0, latest 4.6.0 / 2026-08-11, **127 versions since 2026-03-22**) describes itself as "**Deterministic insurance intelligence primitives for regulated AI agents**", with a 13,362-character README and a dedicated documentation site (`cl-sdk.claritylabs.inc/docs`); its first listed capability is **Document Extraction — source-tree extraction that turns parser products into structured data**.

For RIAA: the value here lies in the two qualifiers "**deterministic**" and "**regulated**" — they describe precisely the hardest threshold for AI adoption in insurance: **supervisors require reproducible and traceable conclusions, while generative models are probabilistic by nature**. The corpus already holds a closely related idea in [[quorumforge]] (deterministic adjudication over agent deliberation records — same input, same bytes, same digest), and CL-SDK supplies the deterministic counterpart **at the document stage**: when turning unstructured policies and clauses into structured data, it aims to make extraction reproducible rather than "slightly different each time". It divides labour with the corpus’s document-extraction family: [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] (Chinese clause dataset), [[suture-vlm]] (underwriting binder difference detection via a VLM), [[erax-vl]] (Vietnamese insurance document extraction) and [[evidence-review-claims]] (image-evidence adjudication); for governance and trust see [[insurance-governance]], [[phi-boundary-gate]] and [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]; for practical agents see [[agrisky-ai]] (agricultural claims assessment, which likewise insists that the model must not rewrite key numbers). Suits document automation, regulated AI and agent engineering.

**Verification note**: the npm metadata and README have been verified; its GitHub repository `claritylabs-inc/cl-sdk` is reachable (Apache-2.0, TypeScript, 2.1MB), but the **repository description and topics are empty and it has only 1 star**, so the capability description here **rests mainly on the npm README and the official documentation site**, with no judgement about implementation quality.
